proposed_complete_public_header:
theorem n04WholeReferenceGaugeAtlas_moving_negative_crossHalf_range
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {R : ReturnEquationData S}
    {L : ReturnCorrectionData S} {base loss baseCur : ℕ} {ε εCur : ℝ}
    (hD : IsAccumulatingProfile D) (hT : IsMaterialData D T)
    (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S)
    (hN : NonlinearPropertiesThrough03 D T S C R L base loss ε)
    (hfield : N04bFieldRegularity D S C L base ε)
    (e0 : ℕ ≃ N04PieceIndex D) (e : ℕ ≃ N04WholePieceIndex D)
    (cell : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → ℕ)
    (ψ χ : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → PolarPoint → PolarPoint)
    (h0 : N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → PolarPoint → ℝ)
    (τ σ : (AnnularState S × ℝ) →
      N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → PolarPoint → PolarPoint)
    (Q : (AnnularState S × ℝ) →
      N04PositiveComponent D.a D.b (deriv D.w) → PolarPoint → ℝ)
    (N : Set ℝ) (hεCur : 0 < εCur)
    (hinc : sectorNeighborhood S baseCur εCur εCur ⊆ sectorNeighborhood S base ε ε) :
    let K := n04bActualTypedAtlas hT hS hN hfield e0
    let V := n04WholeReferenceGaugeAtlasData C L K e cell ψ χ h0 τ σ Q N
    CanonicalGeometry.CurrentJets D T S C L V baseCur εCur →
    ∃ base' : ℕ, baseCur ≤ base' ∧ ∃ ε' : ℝ, 0 < ε' ∧ ε' ≤ εCur ∧
      sectorNeighborhood S base' ε' ε' ⊆ sectorNeighborhood S baseCur εCur εCur ∧
      CanonicalGeometry.CurrentJets D T S C L V base' ε' ∧
      ∀ ζ ∈ sectorNeighborhood S base' ε' ε', ∀ m (side : Bool) (p : PolarPoint),
        p ∈ physicalPieceOpen S V (liftSectorParameter S C ζ)
          (e.symm (.inl (m, side))) →
        let k := e0.symm (.inl (m, side))
        let k' := e0.symm (.inl (m, !side))
        let ρ := n04bRootCutRadius (C.travel m)
        let v := (K.chart (liftSectorParameter S C ζ) k p).1 / ρ
        let u := (K.chart (liftSectorParameter S C ζ) k' p).1 / ρ
        0 < v ∧ v < 1 ∧ 1 < u ∧
          (p ∉ referencePhysicalPieceOpen S K k →
            u ≤ (5 / 4 : ℝ) ∧ (7 / 16 : ℝ) ≤ v)

proof_blocks.proof: After the single shrink, fix state,m,s and p in U_s. Use the exact affine inverse q and negative field equalities to turn the .chartRadial difference into |Rcur_s(p)-Rref_s(p)|<1/4. Reference maps-to gives Rref_s(p)<1, hence Rcur_s(p)<5/4. The atom is normalized by rho and evaluated at fixed-reference physicalUnitPoint; neither point nor scale may be silently replaced.

For p in closure(U_s) intersect Omega_m, use the actual stored component germ and actual root regularity to obtain continuity of Rcur_s at p. Apply the pinned closure_le directly to the preceding interior upper bound. This handles the old cut without its exact reference optical value and without assuming p lies in that side's moving half.

For p in the target moving half but outside its fixed reference open half, the compiled71 classification gives either p at the old cut, or p in a fixed half refSide. The first case lies in closure U_opp by exact endpoint metadata. In the second case refSide=target contradicts the guard, so Bool refSide=!target and p belongs to U_opp, hence its closure. Apply Step2 to get u<=5/4.
Maps-to gives0<v<1. Let hvpow:=Real.rpow_le_self_of_le_one hv.le hvlt.le (by norm_num : (1:ℝ)<=3/2). If u<=1, the same lemma givesu^(3/2)<=u; the exact power sum2 would then be<=v+u<2. Hence1<u.

Use Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le huone.le (by norm_num : (3/2:ℝ)<=2), then Real.rpow_two, to getu^(3/2)<=u². Fromu<=5/4 andu>0, mul_nonneg(sub_nonneg.mpr huUpper)(by linarith : 0<=(5/4:ℝ)+u) givesu²<=25/16. The power sum andv^(3/2)<=v yield7/16<=v by nlinarith. All constants are numerical and independent of state,component,side,sample and derivative order.
